caption:
You’re not falling apart.
You’re in the middle of becoming.

Life transitions have a way of shaking everything loose. The roles, the routines, the version of you that once fit. And yeah, it can feel like you’re losing everything.

But look closer.

What’s leaving is creating space.
Space for what you’ve been asking for, even if you couldn’t fully see it yet.

Fear will try to convince you something’s gone wrong.
That you should go back. Grip tighter. Control it.

But this is the moment to soften your hold.

Stay here. In this breath. In this exact moment.
You don’t need the whole plan, you just need to trust the next step.

The universe isn’t taking from you.
It’s preparing you.

For something bigger.
More aligned.
More honest.
More you.

Let it unfold.

Animation: @auraanimatedhq 💜

author: Heidi Tacktill | Somatic Breathwork
transcript: Just trust me, you'll be fine Universe? Um, I really want this new thing. Huh? Huh? Huh? Huh? Wait! Why did you change everything? To make room. But I want the new thing and everything else! I want it to stay the same, but still get the new thing! Getting this requires you to grow to be eligible for it. In your case, you're being held back by all of these things. So I removed the things holding you back. I chose the safest path for you. But now things are too different. I want to go back. You want to go back to how things were? Yes. It's too scary here now. You can have the life that you used to have. You're allowed to settle or stop progressing whenever you want. But you'll relive the same experiences again and again and again until you integrate them. You'll fall back into your old patterns, be around the same people with the same mindsets that you've outgrown, relive the same feelings, feel the same fears, and be held back by the same apprehension forever. You won't grow or expand. Are you sure you want to go backwards? Now that you put it that way, no, I'm not. But I don't want to be here either. I'm just uncomfortable. Of course you are. You're in between two chapters of your life. You're releasing a lot in order to make room for bigger and better things. You're still on the right path, even if it feels uncomfortable right now. Just relax. You're exactly where you need to be.
title: You're Between Chapters, Not Broken
one_liner: Life transitions feel like loss, but discomfort signals growth, not failure.
key_points: What's leaving your life is creating space for what you've been asking for
Fear urges you to retreat, but going back means repeating the same patterns indefinitely
You're between two chapters — the discomfort is part of the process, not a sign something's wrong
You don't need the full plan, just enough trust to take the next step
